cases.source: const a=new Temporal.Instant(0n),b=new Temporal.Instant(1500000000n);for(const method of ["since","until"]){const positive=method==="until"?a:b,negative=method==="until"?b:a;const p=positive[method](negative,{smallestUnit:"second",roundingMode:"ceil"});const n=negative[method](positive,{smallestUnit:"second",roundingMode:"ceil"});if(p.seconds!==2||n.seconds!==-1)throw 1;}const t=new Temporal.PlainTime(3,30);if(t.until("05:00").hours!==1||t.until("05:00").minutes!==30||t.since("05:00",{largestUnit:"minutes"}).minutes!==-90)throw 2;

let log="",ok=false;try{new Temporal.Instant(0n).until(new Temporal.Instant(1n),{get largestUnit(){log+="l;";return "days";},get roundingIncrement(){log+="i;";return 1;},get roundingMode(){log+="m;";return "trunc";},get smallestUnit(){log+="s;";return "nanosecond";}});}catch(e){ok=e instanceof RangeError;}if(!ok||log!=="l;i;m;s;")throw 1;ok=false;try{new Temporal.Instant(0n).until(new Temporal.Instant(1n),{smallestUnit:"minutes",roundingIncrement:60});}catch(e){ok=e instanceof RangeError;}if(!ok)throw 2;let touched=false;ok=false;try{new Temporal.Instant(0n).until("invalid",{get largestUnit(){touched=true;return "hour";}});}catch(e){ok=e instanceof RangeError;}if(!ok||touched)throw 3;
